title: Kursk official says hackers attacked servers of Governor Khinshtein's live call-in broadcast
date_note: The AiF page gives only its own publication day (25 November); the day of the attack is not stated.
geo_basis: the broadcast is the Kursk governor's; the region is named by the source
summary: AiF reports that hackers attacked the server infrastructure of Kursk Governor Alexander Khinshtein's live call-in broadcast. Anna Pikulina, first deputy minister of information and public communications of the Kursk region, is quoted as saying the attack was recorded. The broadcast had connection problems and was later restored. The article names no attacker and gives no details of the attack.
plain: Hackers attacked the servers behind the Kursk governor's live call-in, a regional official told AiF. The broadcast had connection problems and was later restored. No attacker was named.
exec: A regional official says the servers of the Kursk governor's live call-in were attacked; the broadcast had connection problems before it was restored.

validation.note: One publisher (AiF), quoting a regional government official; no second outlet or regional government page was read.

review.note: Compared official quote, connection problems, restoration, no attacker named against AiF
